findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The cake spatula container in the second drawer of the cake prep area was observed to have debris accumulation. The person-in-charge was informed. Ensure that the container is cleaned and kept free of debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed bakery to have no sanitizer available for use during food preparation. PIC was informed and a sanitizer bucket was prepared, measuring 200ppm quaternary ammonia. Ensure staff have sanitizer available at all times of food preparation or service.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-201.11: Inspector observed a bottle of sanitizer hanging on a shelf next to single service gloves and over food storage bags. The bottle was removed to the proper storage area. The violation is corrected on site. Ensure that employees are properly trained and follow good food protection practices.
(A)-(B) POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be stored to prevent contamination of FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES by separating or locating MATERIALS in area away or below FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES (use partition or store below).

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-501.110: inspector observed freezer coats stored in and around shelves with food items. The coats were removed. Provide proper storage  for employee items. 

(A) Dressing rooms shall be used by EMPLOYEES if the EMPLOYEES regularly change their clothes in the establishment. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of EMPLOYEE clothing and other possessions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the floors in bakery and the shelves in the donut and bread cases to have accumulated soil and crumbs. Clean with greater frequency so that accumulation does not occur. Maintain clean for next routine inspection. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the hand sink nearest the walk-in cooler/freezer to be physically coming away from the wall. Repair the hand sink so it is stable to the wall, caulk as needed to make smooth and easily cleanable. Discussed repairs with PIC. A work order was placed at the time of inspection. The facility has a repair team housed on site to do such repairs. Ensure that sink is stabilized and caulk sealed to the wall by the next routine inspection. 

6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

Observed no paper towels at one of the hand sinks in the bakery area. Discussed with PIC. Ensure paper towels are replaced as needed at hand sinks. PIC obtained new paper towels. COS.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed the hand sink nearest the walk-in cooler/freezer to have caulk, but the sink has been leaned on and is now physically coming away from the wall. Repair the hand sink so it is stable to the wall, caulk as needed to make smooth and easily cleanable. Discussed repairs with PIC. Repair by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. 

(REPEAT) Observed multiple upright baking storage units to have soil on handles and general outside surfaces. Base of units have large accumulation of dust. Discussed frequent cleaning of nonfood-contact surfaces with PIC. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 1/22/20.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed the following areas to be in a state of disrepair and required to be smooth and easily cleanable:
1. Caulk at the utility sink and back hand sink of deli - both have caulk missing and/or coming away from wall and sink. Re-caulk these areas.

Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure repairs are conducted by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Storage for baking utensils (food contact surface) is soiled with dust, dirt, food residue and other debris. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A

Observed multiple plastic storage trays within bakery icing prep area to have small accumulation of debris within. Discussed routinely washing, rinsing, and sanitizing storage container trays with PIC. PIC is in compliance and will correct. COS.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text:
4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on upright baking storage units. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.

Observed multiple upright baking storage units to have soil on handles and general outside surfaces. Discussed frequent cleaning of nonfood-contact surfaces with PIC.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
2 containers of meijer brand pain relief medication stored in drawer on shelf above clean piping tips and clean stainless steel top of West preparation table.  

->Medicines must be located to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single-service and single-use articles. Removed by employee. Reference 7-207.11.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
Employee meijer hat and box of employee food noted stored with containers of icing on bottom shelf of stainless steel preparation table on West wide of bakery. 

->Food shall be protected from contamination. Please store employee personal items in a manner which does not contaminate food, food preparation areas, or clean utensils.  Reference 3-307.11.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Dust noted accumulated on ceiling tiles surrounding the ceiling exhaust vent located across from the large bread proofers.

->Physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Except for cleaning up a spill or other accident, cleaning should be done during periods when the least amount of food is exposed such as after closing.  Reference 6-501.12 (A & B).
